newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close lower on currency factors.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close lower on currency factors.

text.p: Currency again dominated trading on the LIFFE wheat and barley futures markets on Wednesday.
Traders said there was also talk of farm selling which put further pressure on prices.
Wheat closed one to 0.40 stg down after trading 627 lots.
Most active May last traded at 93.25 stg, 0.65 stg down with 341 lots against the position.
Barley closed one stg up to 0.50 stg down on a turnover of 74 lots.
May was the most active position closing at 91.25 stg, 0.50 stg down after trading 46 lots. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
